name: A DVOR-KOLODETS
source:
Our family moved into a newly built apartment complex with a private courtyard. There had always been three of us: me, my sister, and my mother. And our neighbor.
…Wait, what? Why is he creeping into our lives? Why does he keep watching us from the window across the yard? How are things inside our apartment changing? And is the neighbor even alive? Or is something… not alive watching us instead?
translation:
我们一家人搬进了一座新建的公寓大楼，里面有一个私人庭院。我们一直都是三个人：我、我姐姐和我母亲。还有我们的邻居。
……等等，什么？他为什么要闯入我们的生活？他为什么一直从院子对面的窗户看着我们？我们公寓内的情况发生了怎样的变化？邻居还活着吗？或者是有什么东西……不活着在注视着我们？
